F.title: FLOOD ALERT
F.tier1_general: ⚠️ FLOOD ALERT — {area}: Evacuate immediately to {destination}. Water levels rising rapidly. Avoid low-lying roads and underpasses.
F.tier1_agricultural: ⚠️ FLOOD ALERT — Farmers in {area}: Move livestock and equipment to higher ground. Proceed to {destination}. Avoid flooded fields and channels.
F.tier1_elderly: ⚠️ FLOOD ALERT — Senior citizens in {area}: Request immediate assistance to evacuate to {destination}. Do NOT attempt to walk through floodwater. Stay visible.
F.tier1_physically_challenged: ⚠️ FLOOD ALERT — {area}: Accessible evacuation route to {destination}. Mobility-assistance teams have been deployed. Call 112 for immediate help.
F.tier1_volunteers: ⚠️ FLOOD ALERT — Volunteer Responders: Report immediately to {destination}. Assist evacuation from {area}. Carry first-aid kits and flotation devices.
F.tier2_prompt: You are an official emergency response assistant for the Government of India. Generate a clear, urgent flood evacuation alert for {target_audience} located in {area}, Indore. The safe evacuation route passes through: {route_description}. The designated shelter is {destination}. Include the following verified information only — do not add or invent any locations, names, or routes not listed. Keep the message under 200 words. Begin with FLOOD ALERT.
F.fallback: ⚠️ FLOOD ALERT {area}: Move to {destination} immediately. Avoid floodwater. Call 112.

C.title: CYCLONE ALERT
C.tier1_general: ⚠️ CYCLONE ALERT — {area}: Seek shelter immediately at {destination}. Board windows, stay away from trees and power lines. Do NOT go outside.
C.tier1_agricultural: ⚠️ CYCLONE ALERT — Farmers in {area}: Secure livestock in permanent structures. Move to {destination}. Do not stay in field huts or temporary shelters.
C.tier1_elderly: ⚠️ CYCLONE ALERT — Senior citizens in {area}: Move to the inner room at {destination}. Away from windows. Assistance available — call 112.
C.tier1_physically_challenged: ⚠️ CYCLONE ALERT — {area}: Accessible shelter at {destination}. Call 112 for mobility assistance. Avoid open areas and roads.
C.tier1_volunteers: ⚠️ CYCLONE ALERT — Volunteer Responders: Secure your own shelter first at {destination}. After storm passes, assist clearing routes from {area}.
C.tier2_prompt: You are an official emergency response assistant for the Government of India. Generate a clear, urgent cyclone shelter alert for {target_audience} in {area}, Indore. Nearest safe shelter: {destination}. Route: {route_description}. Include only verified locations. Under 200 words. Begin with CYCLONE ALERT.
C.fallback: ⚠️ CYCLONE ALERT {area}: Shelter at {destination}. Stay indoors. Call 112.

L.title: LANDSLIDE ALERT
L.tier1_general: ⚠️ LANDSLIDE ALERT — {area}: Move away from slopes and hillsides immediately. Proceed to {destination}. Avoid hill roads — they may be blocked or unstable.
L.tier1_agricultural: ⚠️ LANDSLIDE ALERT — Farmers in {area}: Leave hillside fields immediately. Do NOT attempt to recover equipment. Proceed to {destination} via flat routes only.
L.tier1_elderly: ⚠️ LANDSLIDE ALERT — Senior citizens in {area}: Evacuate now with assistance to {destination}. Avoid all slopes and hillside paths. Call 112.
L.tier1_physically_challenged: ⚠️ LANDSLIDE ALERT — {area}: Flat accessible route to {destination}. Assistance teams deployed. Call 112 immediately for evacuation support.
L.tier1_volunteers: ⚠️ LANDSLIDE ALERT — Volunteer Responders: Clear flat evacuation corridors from {area} to {destination}. Watch for secondary slides. Do not approach slope areas.
L.tier2_prompt: You are an official emergency response assistant for the Government of India. Generate a landslide evacuation alert for {target_audience} in {area}, Indore. Safe route (avoiding all slopes): {route_description}. Destination: {destination}. Use only verified locations. Under 200 words. Begin with LANDSLIDE ALERT.
L.fallback: ⚠️ LANDSLIDE ALERT {area}: Move to {destination} via flat routes. Avoid slopes. Call 112.

W.title: WILDFIRE ALERT
W.tier1_general: ⚠️ WILDFIRE ALERT — {area}: Evacuate immediately in the direction of {destination}. Move crosswind or upwind — do NOT drive into smoke. Close all windows.
W.tier1_agricultural: ⚠️ WILDFIRE ALERT — Farmers in {area}: Release livestock immediately. Do NOT try to save crops. Move quickly to {destination} via the designated route.
W.tier1_elderly: ⚠️ WILDFIRE ALERT — Senior citizens in {area}: Evacuate NOW with assistance to {destination}. Wet cloth over mouth and nose. Call 112 immediately.
W.tier1_physically_challenged: ⚠️ WILDFIRE ALERT — {area}: Accessible evacuation route to {destination}. Emergency teams dispatched. Call 112 for immediate assistance.
W.tier1_volunteers: ⚠️ WILDFIRE ALERT — Volunteer Responders: Guide civilians from {area} to {destination}. Use the designated crosswind route. Carry wet cloths. Avoid smoke zones.
W.tier2_prompt: You are an official emergency response assistant for the Government of India. Generate a wildfire evacuation alert for {target_audience} in {area}, Indore. Crosswind evacuation route: {route_description}. Destination: {destination}. Verified locations only. Under 200 words. Begin with WILDFIRE ALERT.
W.fallback: ⚠️ WILDFIRE ALERT {area}: Evacuate to {destination}. Move crosswind. Call 112.

E.title: EARTHQUAKE ALERT
E.tier1_general: ⚠️ EARTHQUAKE ALERT — {area}: DROP — COVER — HOLD. If outdoors, move to {destination} open ground. Stay away from buildings. Aftershocks expected.
E.tier1_agricultural: ⚠️ EARTHQUAKE ALERT — Farmers in {area}: Move away from structures and trees immediately. Proceed to open ground at {destination}. Beware of landslides.
E.tier1_elderly: ⚠️ EARTHQUAKE ALERT — Senior citizens in {area}: Drop and take cover. After shaking stops, move carefully to {destination}. Assistance available — call 112.
E.tier1_physically_challenged: ⚠️ EARTHQUAKE ALERT — {area}: After shaking stops, accessible route to {destination} open ground. Do not use elevators. Call 112 for assistance.
E.tier1_volunteers: ⚠️ EARTHQUAKE ALERT — Volunteer Responders: After shaking stops, assemble at {destination}. Check for trapped persons in {area}. Do not enter damaged structures.
E.tier2_prompt: You are an official emergency response assistant for the Government of India. Generate an earthquake safety alert for {target_audience} in {area}, Indore. Post-quake muster point: {destination}. Route (avoiding damaged structures): {route_description}. Verified locations only. Under 200 words. Begin with EARTHQUAKE ALERT.
E.fallback: ⚠️ EARTHQUAKE ALERT {area}: DROP-COVER-HOLD. After shaking, move to {destination}. Call 112.

T.title: TSUNAMI ALERT
T.tier1_general: ⚠️ TSUNAMI ALERT — {area}: Move inland immediately to {destination}. Do NOT wait for visual confirmation of waves. Move on foot if roads are blocked.
T.tier1_agricultural: ⚠️ TSUNAMI ALERT — Farmers in {area}: Leave all equipment. Move immediately inland to {destination}. Tsunami moves faster than you can drive on congested roads.
T.tier1_elderly: ⚠️ TSUNAMI ALERT — Senior citizens in {area}: Evacuate NOW with assistance to {destination}. If you cannot walk, go to the highest nearby floor. Call 112.
T.tier1_physically_challenged: ⚠️ TSUNAMI ALERT — {area}: Move to highest floor or inland to {destination}. Mobility-assistance teams are en route. Call 112.
T.tier1_volunteers: ⚠️ TSUNAMI ALERT — Volunteer Responders: Guide civilians inland to {destination}. Assist those who cannot self-evacuate from {area}. Avoid coastal roads.
T.tier2_prompt: You are an official emergency response assistant for the Government of India. Generate a tsunami evacuation alert for {target_audience} in {area}. Inland evacuation route: {route_description}. High-ground destination: {destination}. Verified locations only. Under 200 words. Begin with TSUNAMI ALERT.
T.fallback: ⚠️ TSUNAMI ALERT {area}: Move inland to {destination} NOW. Do not wait. Call 112.

H.title: HEATWAVE ALERT
H.tier1_general: ⚠️ HEATWAVE ALERT — {area}: Temperature dangerous. Move to air-conditioned shelter at {destination}. Drink water every 15 minutes. Avoid outdoor activity 11am–5pm.
H.tier1_agricultural: ⚠️ HEATWAVE ALERT — Farmers in {area}: Stop outdoor work immediately. Drink water. Move to cool shelter at {destination}. Resume work only after 6pm.
H.tier1_elderly: ⚠️ HEATWAVE ALERT — Senior citizens in {area}: High heat risk. Move to cool shelter at {destination}. Drink ORS. If dizzy or confused, call 112 immediately.
H.tier1_physically_challenged: ⚠️ HEATWAVE ALERT — {area}: Cool, accessible shelter available at {destination}. ORS and medical staff on site. Call 112 for transport assistance.
H.tier1_volunteers: ⚠️ HEATWAVE ALERT — Volunteer Responders: Distribute ORS and water in {area}. Escort vulnerable persons to cooling centre at {destination}. Watch for heat stroke.
H.tier2_prompt: You are an official emergency response assistant for the Government of India. Generate a heatwave safety alert for {target_audience} in {area}, Indore. Cooling centre: {destination}. Route: {route_description}. Include heat safety tips. Verified locations only. Under 200 words. Begin with HEATWAVE ALERT.
H.fallback: ⚠️ HEATWAVE ALERT {area}: Seek shade at {destination}. Drink water. Call 112 if unwell.
